Change has been successfully rebased and submitted as f8eaa4136eecfcbb1c427f1bb2b575437be32d08
is there a design doc on this? Whats the goal with this feature?
There's no separate design doc for this feature - trying to implement a missing part
Why isn't this an enum?
Done

I'd prefer we keep the 0x00/0x01 values, as the MCTP Base specification uses these explicit values to identify the two VDM types.

Open to disageement on that, of course, but the int proposal isn't an arbitrary choice.
Acknowledged
Why would we make this a variant?  Just use a uint64.  It's way simpler on the implmentation.
Done

... because DSP0236 may define future VDM formats that are not representable as uint64.

That's somewhat unlikely, but would then require a new (properly versioned!) property definition.

and we already have the (uint8, variant, uint16) format (`yvq`) for the VDM type registration: https://github.com/CodeConstruct/mctp/blob/main/docs/mctpd.md#registervdmtypesupport-yvq - of which this is somewhat symmetrical.
Hi @patrick@stwcx.xyz Can you share feedback on the suggestion ?
@jk@ozlabs.org , @andrew@codeconstruct.com.au - Does the mctp daemon consume this interface or is it used just by entity-manager/mctpreactor?

`mctpd` publishes this, for consumption by other applications that may want to discover an endpoint that advertises support for a particular upper-layer protocol (in this case, a vendor-defined one). I assume the reactors would also consume this, but perhaps not in the case of VDM types?

My preference here would be for that protocol-type representation to closely match the representation described in the MCTP Base spec, in using the uint8 for the format, and variant for the type data.
Acknowledged
Just to clarify: I think the structure introduced in patchset 2 is the way to go here.
Acknowledged.  @nidhin.ms@intel.com - Please revert to the style in PS2.
Done
This doesn't look like patchset 2 though?

Hi @jk@ozlabs.org 

I changed type def from patchset 2

array[struct[byte,variant[uint16, uint32],uint16]]
to
array[struct[enum[self.VendorIdFormat],variant[uint16, uint32],uint16]]

Only diff I tried to make is the enum. Is that what you meant ?

No, I was suggesting the change as-is from patchset 2. So:

```
type: array[struct[byte,variant[uint16, uint32],uint16]]
```
Done
Looks good to me - one comment inline for a potential improvement in the description, but that would also seem fine as a later change if you prefer.

the property definition looks good to me.

I would also suggest indicating that the format specifier and PCIe/IANA format are defined by DSP0236, and so may be augmented if that specification is updated.

The aim here would be to indicate that implementers should gracefully handle format specifiers that they don't understand (ie, the description is non-exhaustive), and therefore the variant types associated.

However, that would be fine as a later change if you have no other need to re-roll this patch.
Done

Hi @jk@ozlabs.org 
Is the new changes OK ?
Yep, looks great! I thought I had already +1ed, but evidently not.
Spec and wording both look good, thanks!
